SkyPerch_Text_Npc0.en: Look up. Half the sky here is a\nPOKéMON.
SkyPerch_Text_Npc0.fr: Regarde en haut. La moitié du ciel\nici est un POKéMON.

SkyPerch_Text_Npc1.en: SWABLU loves clouds. ALTARIA is its\nsong.
SkyPerch_Text_Npc1.fr: TYLTON adore les nuages. ALTARIA\nest son chant.

SkyPerch_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

SkyPerch_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
SkyPerch_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
